topic: How a technician restores a desk lamp

scenes.title: THE LAMP GOES DARK
scenes.subtitle: Find the power source.
scenes.narration: The desk lamp goes dark. A technician walks over to check its power source.

scenes.title: LIFT THE BATTERY
scenes.subtitle: A careful, controlled pickup.
scenes.narration: She reaches for the battery and carefully lifts it from the worktable.

scenes.title: LOOK FOR DAMAGE
scenes.subtitle: A closer inspection.
scenes.narration: Holding it close, she checks the contacts for damage and signs of corrosion.

scenes.title: SET IT DOWN
scenes.subtitle: Controlled placement on the table.
scenes.narration: She lowers the battery onto the table beside the lamp, ready for testing.

scenes.title: LIGHT RETURNS
scenes.subtitle: Verify that electricity is flowing.
scenes.narration: Finally, she tests the lamp. A bright glow signals that electricity is flowing again.
